## Notes

- Marketing site. Public, unauthenticated pages only. The authenticated app lives in [`apps/studio`](../studio/).
- Shared UI, lib, and i18n come from [`@wowlab/shared`](../../packages/shared/). Import from there, never duplicate.
- Blog and content pages are built from markdown with [velite](https://velite.js.org/) (`velite.config.ts`).
- Copy is wired through intlayer (`intlayer.config.ts`). Load the `intlayer` skill before touching strings.
- Deployed to Cloudflare via OpenNext (`open-next.config.ts`, `wrangler.jsonc`).
